description: This source file defines the GLWorld class, which manages 3D shape data, buffers, and rendering logic for OpenGL ES rendering within an Android graphics application.

classes.name: GLWorld
classes.description: A class responsible for managing a collection of 3D shapes, vertices, and buffers, and rendering them using OpenGL ES.

methods.name: addShape
methods.description: Adds a shape to the world and updates the total index count.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates buffers for vertices, colors, and indices from the stored shape and vertex lists.

methods.name: addVertex
methods.description: Creates a new vertex at specified coordinates, adds it to the vertex list, and returns it.

methods.name: transformVertex
methods.description: Transforms a given vertex using a transformation matrix.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the shape collection using provided OpenGL context.

methods.name: toFloat
methods.description: Converts an integer to a float in fixed-point format.
